name: omp-slack
description: Slack bridge for omp (Bolt Socket Mode + omp --mode rpc-ui)

omp.name: Slack
omp.description: Chat with omp from Slack; /slack manages the bridge service

allowedUsers.description: Slack member IDs allowed to command the agent, comma-separated (Slack profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID, e.g. U012AB3CD)

cwd.description: Default project directory; changing it switches the bridge there with a fresh session (!cd does the same from Slack). Empty = home

model.description: Model override as provider/id, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 (empty = your omp default role)

progress.description: Show tool steps in one live-edited Slack message per turn
